assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D pixel art sprite atlas for a classic blue-window JRPG materia equipment menu.
Primary request: one transparent 1024x1024 sprite sheet containing exactly TWO separate UI sprites: an empty SINGLE materia socket in the upper half, and an empty LINKED PAIR of matching sockets in the lower half.
Style: beautiful handcrafted detailed SNES/PlayStation-era pixel art, crisp square pixels, restrained silver and cool gunmetal palette, strong upper-left highlight, polished beveled metal collars, dark navy recessed circular centers ready to receive the game's existing colored orb sprites. Front view, perfectly flat HUD elements, no perspective.
Precise layout: upper sprite is ONE circular metal socket centered at (256,256), about 320 pixels outer diameter. Lower sprite consists of TWO IDENTICAL matching circular sockets centered at (256,768) and (768,768), same 320 pixel outer diameter. Join the lower two with a beautifully machined silver bridge, short horizontal inset rails and a narrow blue-black groove. Clear unmistakable paired link. All parts of the lower bridge must remain between the two ring silhouettes, no protrusions above/below the circles. Generous transparent empty padding between upper and lower sprites. Upper-right quadrant is empty. Outer circles aligned exactly vertically so upper single can be compared to lower left socket.
Rendering: visibly pixelated contours, approximately 40 logical pixels diameter per socket enlarged in crisp integer pixel blocks, detailed confident metal highlights, dark interior, readable silhouette when reduced to 28px tall. Use subtle decorative notches on the collars, elegant and functional, no excessive ornament.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background everywhere outside the two sprites. No background panel, no colored materia balls, no glow outside, no shadows cast on background, no checkerboard drawing, no lettering, no labels, no numerals, no logos, no watermark. Only these two sprites.
